project.name: finanxe
project.description: Personal finance tracker: debts, goals, calendar, and financial snapshots.

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Get the user's current financial snapshot (cash position, income, debt totals, debt-to-income ratio).

tools.name: list_debts
tools.description: List the user's debts and their available funding accounts.

tools.name: set_debt_funding
tools.description: Redirect which account a debt is paid from, by debt name and account description.
tools.generic_callable_reason: the real /api/debt/funding route takes a raw debt id, not a name — sutra's hand-written finanxe adapter resolves a debt name and account description to that id and the matching linked account first (fuzzy name matching, bank-nickname aliases, digit-mask/token-overlap scoring), which can't be expressed as a plain HTTP call
